text: stress, family pressure, that exhausted voice where someone has already replayed, every
possible solution before calling you, I immediately slipped into problem solving mode, budgeting
apps, freelance ideas, optimization plans, then he went quite and said, yeah I know all
that, and it hit me, he didn't call because he needed a strategist, he called because
he didn't want to feel alone, inside the pressure anymore, so I stopped trying to solve
him and just said, that sounds unbelievably heavy, the entire tone of the conversation
changed after that, some moments don't need a mechanic, they need a witness, here is
the version of strength, we have been sold, handle it yourself, show no cracks, keep moving,
